1. A system for analysing risk associated with an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including means for use in generating __a__ user interface for display on a user terminal, said user interface showing a distribution of assets of each investment of the investment portfolio over one or more asset classes and showing the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of a benchmark risk category representing a risk tolerance level of the investor, __wherein said system does not include means for adding or removing an investment from the investment portfolio.__ (Currently amended)

4. A system for managing an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including the system for analysing claimed in any one of claims 1 to 3 and including means for use in __adding or__ an investment to the investment portfolio. (Currently amended)

5. A system for managing an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including the system for analysing claimed in any one of claims 1 to 3 and including means for use in __removing or__ an investment from the investment portfolio. (Currently amended)

10. The system claimed in any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein said investments of the investment portfolio are __not limited to__ fund managers. (Currently amended)

11. The system claimed in any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein said investments of the investment portfolio are __not limited to__ direct shares. (Currently amended)

12. A computer program for analysing risk associated with an investment portfolio of an investor, said program for performing the step of generating __a__ user interface for display on a user terminal, said user interface showing the distribution of assets of each investment of the investment portfolio over one or more asset classes and also showing a distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of a benchmark risk category representing the risk tolerance level of the investor, __wherein said program does not include means for adding or removing an investment from the investment portfolio.__ (Currently amended)

15. A computer program for managing an investment portfolio of an investor, said computer program for performing the steps claimed in any one of claims 12 to 14 and performing the step of __adding or__ an investment to investment portfolio. (Currently amended)

16. A computer program for managing an investment portfolio of an investor, said computer program for performing the steps claimed in any one of claims 12 to 14 and performing the step of __removing or__ an investment from the investment portfolio. (Currently amended)

20. The computer program claimed in any one of claims 18 to 19, said another user interface including means for __not limited to__ allocating a proportion of the investor's assets to each investment of the investment portfolio. (Currently amended)

38. The method claimed in any one of claims 24 to 37, wherein said investments of the investment portfolio are __not limited to__ fund managers. (Currently amended)

39. The method claimed in any one of claims 24 to 37, wherein said investments of the investment portfolio are __not limited to__ direct shares. (Currently amended)
